theme_rankings.tagline: 🤖 크립토 버전 AI 베팅 — 분산 컴퓨팅·에이전트
theme_rankings.why_now: AI Capex 사이클의 크립토 노출. 미국 AI 주식 테마와 동행 흐름.
theme_rankings.risk: 내러티브 의존도 큼. 실수요 검증 아직 미흡. 알트 변동성 폭.

theme_rankings.why_now: 실제 매출 + 토큰 보유자 환원. P/S 가시화로 밸류에이션 재평가 단계.
theme_rankings.risk: 스마트컨트랙트 위험 + 규제. 매출은 시장 변동성에 큰 폭으로 변동.

theme_rankings.tagline: 🌐 검증된 L1 — 이더 외 실수요 입증된 체인들
theme_rankings.why_now: 솔라나 압도적 점유 + 신흥 L1(Sui·Aptos)도 자금 유입. 생태계 prop value 확보.
theme_rankings.risk: L1 간 경쟁 격화. 사용자·개발자 이탈 시 멀티플 빠르게 축소.

theme_rankings.tagline: 📈 ETF 승인 후보 + 이더 L2 — 기관 매집 영역
theme_rankings.why_now: SOL·LTC ETF 가능성 + L2 거래량 회복. 다음 cycle 메이저 후보.
theme_rankings.risk: ETF 미승인 시 단기 조정. L2는 fee market 경쟁 심화.

theme_rankings.why_now: 토큰 가격은 하락했지만 매출 폭증 중. AI Capex 사이클의 크립토 노출 직접.
theme_rankings.risk: 토큰 인플레이션 압력 + 사용자 보상 의존. 베어 마켓에서 매도 압력 큼.

theme_rankings.why_now: 거버넌스보단 실제 트래픽·결제 사용처. TON·BNB 일일 활성 유저 검증.
theme_rankings.risk: 투기 대비 변동성 낮지만 폭발력도 작음. 환희장에서 underperform.

theme_rankings.tagline: 🥇 시장 방향성 기준 — 비트는 디지털 금, 이더는 인프라
theme_rankings.why_now: BTC ETF 자금 유입, ETH 스테이킹 + L2 매출. 알트 사이클의 출발점.
theme_rankings.risk: 거시 유동성·금리에 직접 노출. ETF 자금 흐름이 단기 방향성을 좌우.

theme_rankings.why_now: 기관 자금 유입 가장 빠른 영역. BlackRock·Franklin 등 진입.
theme_rankings.risk: 규제 의존적. 거시 금리 환경 변화 시 단기 자금 이탈 가능.

top_news.title: Asian Stocks to Gain on Tech Optimism, Oil Falls: Markets Wrap
top_news.summary: Asian stocks were poised to climb after a tech-fueled rally on Wall Street and a drop in oil prices amid hopes for diplomatic progress in the Iran war.

top_news.title: Vietnam’s Leader Declares US Trade Deal Close
top_news.summary: Vietnam’s top leader To Lam tells Bloomberg the nation is “very close” to a trade deal with the US. Vietnam wants to import more US items, Lam says in an exclusive interview on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Ecuador Asks US Daily to Help Curb $30 Billion Cocaine Trade
top_news.summary: Ecuador asks the US ‘every day’ for more help fighting a cocaine trade worth an estimated $30 billion a year, President Daniel Noboa said Monday, while insisting local security forces should remain in charge.

top_news.title: Paramount settles lawsuits, allowing for Warner Bros. deal
top_news.summary: Paramount Skydance has settled lawsuits brought by 12 state attorneys general and the Writers Guild trade union, a move that will allow the company to close its historic $110 billion acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery. Erik Larson reports. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: US Plans $5 Billion Middle East Reconstruction Fund for Iran War
top_news.summary: The Trump administration has proposed a $5 billion fund to help rebuild critical infrastructure across the Middle East damaged in the war with Iran even though the seven-month conflict continues.

top_news.title: Oil Settles Near $100 as Hormuz Flows Stunt Rally
top_news.summary: Oil fell Monday, settling near $100 a barrel, on signs Saudi Arabia is boosting exports via the key Strait of Hormuz and fresh hopes for diplomatic progress in the Iran war. Brent, the global benchmark, declined for a fourth session, settling 3.4% lower. top_news.title: CoreWeave-Tied Data Center Project Kicks Off Junk-Bond Offering
top_news.summary: A group of banks led by Goldman Sachs Group Inc. has kicked off the sale of a roughly $1.1 billion junk bond to finance construction of a data center sponsored by affiliates of Blue Owl Capital Inc. and leased to CoreWeave Inc..

top_news.title: Test Your ETF Knowledge In Our IQ Test
top_news.summary:
Bloomberg's Scarlet Fu puts Eric Balchunas, Matt Kaufman of Calamos Investments, and Brittany Christensen at Tidal to the test on "Bloomberg ETF IQ" in this week's edition of "IQ Test."
 (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: GameStop Rises After CEO Cohen Buys $26.4 Million of Shares
top_news.summary: GameStop shares rose 3% in postmarket trading after CEO Ryan Cohen reported an insider stock transaction to the US Securities and Exchange Commission.

top_news.title: Just Salad CEO Nick Kenner on Brunson partnership
top_news.summary: Just Salad CEO Nick Kenner sat down with Bloomberg's Romaine Bostick to discuss the partnership with Knicks champ Jalen Brunson, how the deal came about and how the company plans to take advantage of the Knicks championship win. (Source: Bloomberg)
